headline: CAE to sell Flightscape unit to SITA for $500 million
summary: CAE agreed to sell its Flightscape unit to SITA for $500 million.
why: CAE is a high-technology company providing simulation training and aviation support solutions. Divestitures of non-core units allow industrial firms to streamline operations and reallocate capital.

impacts.name: CAE Inc.
impacts.why: Asset sales generate cash proceeds that can be used for debt reduction or core business investments.
